replacement_items.content: Engine/thermodynamics analogy plus biological-intelligence distributed-network and adaptive-memory-substrate applications.

Expansion beyond correction accumulates divergence; core failure is loss of ability to become less wrong; current LLMs are source-described as high-representation/high-generation systems with limited direct reality coupling during inference and named failure modes including hallucination, outdated knowledge, and plausible unsupported outputs.
Correction-event criteria plus proposed measurements and next empirical stages: measurable primitives, simulations, controlled perturbations, and stability-boundary identification.
Definitions of memory gravity, crossover round, memory-gravity index, error curve, authority-decay slope, and false-demotion rate.
V-disabled and vector-RAG baselines are predicted to show high memory gravity/flat error curves; the benchmark also predicts that the accuracy-per-round error curve rises under successful correction.

Scenario seeding, scale/seeds, round loop, run length, V-disabled ablation, RAG/recency baselines, public-SDK/reproducibility requirements, success criteria, and the joint low-gravity/low-false-demotion criterion.
Cross-domain failure examples, the structural distributed-human loop example, and persistent memory as study substrate.

Prediction alone does not solve reality coupling; error must feed correction; current AI limitations are framed around persistent reality-grounded updating/recovery; human intelligence is source-described as stabilized by external correction networks, with civilization functioning as a large-scale feedback system.
Definitions of E*, e_c, correction frequency f_c, w_c, C_cap, adaptation, representation, reachability, permeability, divergence, correction deficit/restoration.

Ways correction capacity can increase, instrumental representation value, reachability-gain interpretation of correction, and the claim that high correction frequency is not automatically better because correction strategies may trade frequency against magnitude.

Mappings for reality interaction, signatures, pressure, decay, Mesh sharing as a possible coupling mechanism, and correction events; the permeability formula itself is separated into the formal destination.
Framework/Azus correspondence loop, proposed telemetry Psi=[K_c,P_i,L,Theta,eta_c], and proposed permeability measurement Theta=externally forced structural updates/total structural updates.

Representation value via reachability, selective reinforcement, need for restoration/removal mechanisms, and the source proposal that Azus is approximately a visible adaptive-dynamics laboratory whose target property is preserving the ability to become less wrong.
Experiment: Correction Loop Simulation.
Variable sweep, five parameter/restoration classes, and explicit falsification criteria; substantive core claim is separated into the hypothesis destination.

Stability bound dOmega_ground/dt<=Theta*C_cap, divergence condition dOmega_nominal/dt>Theta*C_cap, and the substantive hypothesis that adaptive structure cannot sustainably outpace reality-mediated correction.
Correction-magnitude examples and frequency/magnitude strategy examples; the non-universality claim is separated into the conceptual destination.
Representation value is proposed proportional to grounded reachability gain; no single correction-frequency/correction-magnitude balance is asserted to be universally optimal.
Definitions of permeability, correction event/magnitude/frequency/capacity, nominal/grounded reachability, correction deficit, correction efficiency, and equation summary.

Grounded expansion/conservation bounds, conditional divergence-versus-grounded-adaptation claims, and the hypothesis that healthy systems repair efficiently while failing systems require increasing effort for decreasing correction.

added_items.content: The repository describes itself as a theoretical framework.
The correction-loop simulation is scoped to testing stability conditions of an adaptive control loop and explicitly does not attempt to model intelligence directly.

occurrence_policy: All replacement/added items retain source occurrence accounting; more than one source unit does not establish warrant independence. WARRANT_INDEPENDENCE_STATUS remains NOT_ESTABLISHED and WARRANT_MULTIPLICITY_EFFECT remains NONE unless independently warranted; no R19 item earns such independence.
